sql.query: SELECT rp.id AS grantId FROM tbl_user_tenants ut INNER JOIN tbl_user_tenant_roles utr ON utr.userId=ut.userId AND utr.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=utr.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='tenant.users.view' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE ut.userId=:userId AND ut.tenantId=:tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active' LIMIT 1

data.message: You do not have permission to view tenant users.

sql.query: SELECT u.id AS userId,u.displayName,u.email,ut.membershipStatus,ut.isActive FROM tbl_user_tenants ut INNER JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=ut.userId WHERE u.id=:userId AND ut.tenantId=:tenantId LIMIT 1

sql.query: SELECT utr.roleId,r.roleName FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=:tenantId AND utr.isActive=1 ORDER BY r.roleName
